text: “Has Monsieur Fogg dared—fifty-five thousand pounds! Well, there’s all the more reason for not losing an instant,” he continued, getting up hastily. Fix pushed Passepartout back in his chair, and resumed: “Fifty-five thousand pounds; and if I succeed, I get two thousand pounds. If you’ll help me, I’ll let you have five hundred of them.” “Help you?” cried Passepartout, whose eyes were standing wide open. “Yes; help me keep Mr. Fogg here for two or three days.” “Why, what are you saying?
